---
name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible problem in an active Aspiland project or repository workflow
title: "Bug: "
labels: ""
assignees: ""
---

## Affected component

Identify the project, path, script, workflow or documentation page.

## Observed behaviour

What happened?

## Expected behaviour

What should have happened?

## Reproduction

Provide the smallest safe reproduction using synthetic or non-sensitive data.

## Environment

Include relevant versions, operating system and configuration without credentials, tokens, private URLs or personal information.

## Impact

Who or what is affected? Does the problem involve data loss, access, privacy, security, accessibility or persistent state?

## Logs or evidence

Redact secrets, personal data and sensitive infrastructure details. For vulnerabilities, leaked credentials or exposed personal information, stop and report privately according to `SECURITY.md` instead of opening a public issue.

## Workaround and rollback

Describe any safe workaround and how a failed fix can be reversed.
